title: CORS Send and Get origin
product-requirement: Applicatons need to be able make request to external domains to load content.
specification:
1.6.1 XMLHttpRequest support
The terminal MUST support the XMLHttpRequest (XHR) object [5]. The terminal MUST support CORS, enabling cross-origin data retrieval
assertion: Make a request to a server on a separate origin, you can confirm the response can read the domain from the request.
